subject: Rolling invoice statement: split lines by legal entity + APAC VAT handling
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nimbushealth.com>, finance@nimbushealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Rolling invoice statement: split lines by legal entity + APAC VAT handling

Hi Maria / Nimbus finance team,

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our call, here's a concise proposal for how Redwood can issue rolling invoices to support your multi-entity APAC setup while preserving your internal cost-centers. High level: we will issue a single monthly invoice per account that contains multiple line items — one line per Redwood legal entity that provided services during the period — plus an explanatory statement mapping line items to your cost centers. VAT will be handled per-line using the supplier VAT registration number for the issuing legal entity.

Key asks from your side:
- Confirm the target split for the pilot month (we suggest using the allocation by product usage + region if you have that)
- Provide VAT registration numbers for each local entity that will receive an invoice
- Confirm payment terms (we assume Net 30 unless you'd like Net 45)

Attached: apac_split_invoice_template_v1.xlsx (sample invoice + statement).

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm VAT numbers and cost-center mapping by end of week (May 21).
2) Redwood issues a pilot invoice for June usage using split-lines and cost-center tags.
3) We validate reconciliation details with your AP team and iterate template once.

If helpful, we can include accounting codes and a per-line cost-center tag that maps to a CSV you can ingest into your ERP.

Thanks,

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: apac_split_invoice_template_v1.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nimbushealth.com>, finance@nimbushealth.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rolling invoice statement: split lines by legal entity + APAC VAT handling

On Mon, May 17, 2027 at 09:15 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Maria / Nimbus finance team,
> 
> Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our call, here's a concise proposal for how Redwood can issue rolling invoices to support your multi-entity APAC setup while preserving your internal cost-centers. High level: we will issue a single monthly invoice per account that contains multiple line items — one line per Redwood legal entity that provided services during the period — plus an explanatory statement mapping line items to your cost centers. VAT will be handled per-line using the supplier VAT registration number for the issuing legal entity.

Sounds good — two quick clarifications from accounting:
1) For the CSV mapping, can you confirm whether your ERP prefers a single combined file with multiple columns (entity, ledger code, cost_center, project) or separate per-entity files? We usually deliver the single combined CSV unless a customer requests separate files.
2) Will you need us to include the VAT rate applied per line in the invoice CSV (recommended for faster matching)?

I attached a small sample mapping we often use for pilots — entity_mapping_csv.csv. I'll draft the pilot invoice in our system once we have the VAT numbers.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Manager, Billing Ops
Redwood Inference
[attachment: entity_mapping_csv.csv (CSV)]

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@nimbushealth.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 02:27:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Rolling invoice statement: split lines by legal entity + APAC VAT handling

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Appreciate the clear plan. A few items from our side:
- We can accept a single combined CSV with the columns you listed (entity, ledger code, cost_center, project). That makes intake simpler for AP.
- Please include the VAT rate per line in the CSV.
- Attached is our current VAT registry list for the group — please use these registration numbers when populating the invoice lines.
- Payment terms: Net 30 is fine for the pilot.

One more ask: would you include a short human-readable statement on the invoice that shows how the total maps to our internal cost centers? Our team relies on that for quick approvals.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Head of Finance Operations
Nimbus Health
[attachment: nimbus_vat_numbers.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rolling invoice statement: split lines by legal entity + APAC VAT handling

Thanks Maria — this is great.

Action plan from Redwood billing ops (Ben):
- We'll generate the pilot invoice for June usage using the attached template. Each invoice will have:
  * multiple invoice lines (one per Redwood legal entity)
  * a 1-page statement mapping lines to Nimbus cost-center codes
  * per-line VAT rate and supplier VAT registration number
  * a combined CSV (entity, ledger code, cost_center, project, vat_rate) for your ERP ingestion

- Pilot timeline: we will populate the June invoice the week of June 7 and share a draft PDF + CSV by June 10 for your review.
- If approved, final invoice will be issued June 15 and payment expected Net 30.

I will put a DocuSign MOU for the pilot changes (small amendment to billing appendix) and share the link — please sign to confirm the pilot scope so we can proceed.
